sql: SELECT [id], [region], [segment], [product], [fiscal_year] AS [fiscalYear], [amount], [quantity] FROM [sales_fact] WHERE ([region] = @p1 AND [segment] = @p2) ORDER BY CASE WHEN [product] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, [product] COLLATE Latin1_General_CI_AS ASC, CASE WHEN [id] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, [id] ASC OFFSET @p3 ROWS FETCH NEXT @p4 ROWS ONLY
